cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 contact-only role causes A3 request for a duplicate; B4 treasurer condition changes A5 email delegation. The standard line is detachable.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects responsibility and B4 states a plausible document-release condition; each changes the route A can use.

heightening.evidence: A5 pushes B4 treasurer involvement into drafting and chasing, clearly maintaining the Drive.
